responsibility: Defines the main data structures and APIs for Rust macro expansion in GCC. This header introduces expansion configuration, matched-fragment bookkeeping for macro_rules! metavariables and repetitions, the substitution-scope stack used while matching rules, and the MacroExpander object itself, including context tracking, cfg-attribute handling, rule matching, transcription, eager invocation expansion, recursion-limit state, and storage for the last expanded fragment and resolver/mappings connections used by the front end.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the macro-expansion framework itself: ExpansionCfg, matched-fragment and substitution-scope bookkeeping, ContextType, and the MacroExpander API/state that other files depend on. The paired .cc file performs the runtime rule matching, transcription, reparsing, and expansion flow using those definitions.
